name: Critical capacity mutation with external confirmation

classification.rationale: The simulated flow changes critical capacity and treats duplication or loss as material harm. It therefore requires Level C semantics such as durable idempotency, ordered state transitions and reconciliation, even though no real inventory, money or provider is used by the fixture.

cufs.goal: Apply one critical capacity mutation and reconcile its external confirmation without duplicating the effect.
cufs.precondition: The fixture database modules for inbox/outbox/idempotency are available in the isolated test database.
steps: Create or claim the logical operation with a durable idempotency key.
Record the outbound intent before crossing the external boundary.
Accept repeated and out-of-order inbound events without duplicating the logical effect.
Reprocess safely and reconcile to an authoritative terminal state.
cufs.observable_result: One logical mutation survives duplicate, retry and out-of-order delivery while preserving an auditable state history.
cufs.integrations: simulated external boundary using inbox/outbox fixtures; no network provider

disclaimer: Synthetic Hache Base fixture only. It exercises Level C contracts in isolated tests and contains no real payment, inventory, personal data or provider traffic.
